full_judgment:
Md Fazlul Karim J: This petition for leave to appeal at the instance of the plaintiff-petitioner impugned judgment and order dated 28-8-1996 of the High Court Division making the Rule absolute in Civil Re vision No. 1101 of 1990 setting aside the judgment and decree dated 10-4-1990 passed by the Senior Assistant Judge, Dhaka in SCC Suit No. 115 of 1987. 

 3. The defendant-respondent contested the suit denying the allegations inter alia, of any service of the notice under section 106 of the Transfer of Property Act stating that plaintiff-petitioner having refused to accept the rent the same is being deposited every month in House Rent Control Case No. 171 of 1972. Although the premises required repairs but the same is not being done in spite of request which has compelled the defendant to seek permission to undertake repair work to the suit shop in House Rent Case No. 35 of 1986. The suit having been decreed by the learned SCC Judge, the respondent moved the High Court Division and the Rule was made absolute setting aside the impugned judgment and decree, decreeing the suit by the learned SSC Judge.
